computations.title: Drik sidereal planetary longitudes
computations.summary: Swiss Ephemeris longitudes under the selected ayanamsa form the Drik astronomical basis.
computations.time_basis: UTC Julian day; ayanamsa is explicit and defaults to Lahiri.

provenance.note: Representative Drik cells are independently compared; the full range remains broader than those cells.

limitations: Accuracy and conventions inherit Swiss Ephemeris and the chosen ayanamsa.

computations.title: Surya Siddhanta mean-motion longitudes
computations.summary: A bounded transcription of mean-motion and manda corrections produces solar and lunar longitudes for the Surya Siddhanta engine.
computations.time_basis: Julian day relative to the engine's Kali epoch constants.

provenance.note: The algorithm family is source-traced in part; production outputs remain regression-pinned rather than independently compared.

limitations: This is not a complete textual transcription; direct floating-point trigonometry and simplified epoch/apogee constants intentionally differ from a full traditional procedure and from modern Drik positions.

computations.title: Provisional Vakya lunar longitude
computations.summary: A provisional nine-value project offset alters the inherited Surya Siddhanta lunar model.
computations.time_basis: Julian day with inherited Surya Siddhanta solar longitude.

provenance.note: No registered source derives the nine-value/3,031-day model; issue 176 tracks source reconstruction and possible correction.

limitations: The current model must not be described as a faithful 248-entry lunar-vākya table or as independently verified against a published Vakya Panchangam.

computations.title: Planetary Asta and Udaya calendar
computations.summary: Swiss Ephemeris heliacal events produce per-location combustion setting and rising periods.
outputs: combustion periods with Asta and Udaya instants
computations.time_basis: UTC heliacal event search converted for the requested location.

provenance.note: Swiss Ephemeris event behavior is tested, but independent event-cell comparisons are not yet registered.

limitations: Heliacal visibility depends on observer, atmosphere, altitude, and Swiss Ephemeris modeling; the current fixed atmosphere and per-planet visibility parameters were tuned against a 2026 Hyderabad comparison set.

computations.title: Solar and lunar eclipse events
computations.summary: Global eclipse searches are combined with per-location visibility and Sutak timing.
computations.time_basis: Swiss Ephemeris UTC events; Sutak is a fixed pre-end interval when locally visible.

provenance.note: Event calculations are regression-pinned; the Sutak convention is a separate textual claim.

limitations: Local visibility is modeled and Sutak is omitted when the eclipse is not visible, but the current observer altitude is fixed to zero.

computations.title: Graha Yuddha periods
computations.summary: Planetary-war entry, closest approach, victor, and exit are derived for tara graha pairs.
computations.time_basis: UTC Julian-day numerical search.

provenance.note: Numerical boundaries are tested; the one-degree admission and latitude-victor rules need claim-level registry locators.

limitations: The result implements the project's documented one-degree and latitude rule, not every tradition's definition.

computations.title: Planetary rashi ingresses
computations.summary: Sidereal sign changes, including retrograde re-entry, are found over a requested range.
computations.time_basis: UTC Julian-day crossing search.

provenance.note: Crossing behavior is regression-tested; independent event-cell evidence is not registered.

limitations: Moon is excluded and results follow the fixed sidereal model used by this module.

computations.title: Anandadi Yoga
computations.summary: A weekday and Nakshatra table assigns one of the 28 Anandadi Yogas.
computations.time_basis: Panchangam day and its active Nakshatra.

provenance.note: The table is regression-tested but still belongs to the broader derived-classification locator gap.

limitations: The table is a named textual convention, not an astronomical observation.

computations.title: Bhadra Mukha and Puchha windows
computations.summary: Vishti Karana duration is partitioned into Tithi-specific Bhadra face and tail windows.
computations.time_basis: Observed Vishti duration expressed on the sunrise-anchored Ghati scale.

provenance.note: The verse mapping and computation contract are registered as verified.

limitations: This implements the registered Tithi/Yama mapping and does not blend conflicting published tables.

computations.title: Disha Shoola direction
computations.summary: A weekday table returns the traditionally avoided travel direction.
computations.time_basis: Sunrise-anchored Panchangam weekday.

provenance.note: The table is tested but its exact edition locator remains part of derived-classification debt.

limitations: Travel-direction rules vary by lineage and remedies are not automated.

computations.title: Sunrise-anchored Ghati clock
computations.summary: The interval from sunrise to next sunrise is divided into 60 proportional Ghatis.
computations.time_basis: Local sunrise to next local sunrise, divided into 60 equal parts.

provenance.note: Conversion behavior is tested; the textual use of scaled Ghatis is covered only in part.

limitations: A Ghati is proportional to that local sunrise-to-sunrise interval, not fixed to civil minutes.

computations.title: Khar Maasa classification
computations.summary: Solar sign classifies Dhanu or Meena periods as Khar Maasa.
computations.time_basis: Solar rashi at the Panchangam-day snapshot.

provenance.note: The classification is tested but remains under the broad locator gap.

limitations: Its effect depends on the activity profile; the flag alone is not an absolute verdict.

computations.title: Thirty named Muhurtas
computations.summary: Day and night are each divided into fifteen named proportional Muhurtas.
computations.time_basis: Fifteen equal day parts and fifteen equal night parts.

provenance.note: The checked table is maintained in docs/reference/07-muhurta-table.md and parity-tested.

limitations: Names and dispositions follow the project's verified table; other almanacs may label variants differently.

computations.title: Nakshatra Mukha direction
computations.summary: Nakshatras are classified as Adho, Urdhva, or Tiryan Mukha.
computations.time_basis: Active Nakshatra at the evaluated day or slot.

provenance.note: Classification behavior is tested; exact source locators remain incomplete.

limitations: The direction is an activity input, not a general day-quality score.

computations.title: Panchaka Nakshatra flag
computations.summary: Dhanishtha through Revati are marked for activity-specific Panchaka restrictions.
computations.time_basis: Active Nakshatra.

provenance.note: The set is tested; individual activity consequences have separate provenance where available.

limitations: Restrictions are activity-specific and should not be presented as a universal prohibition.

computations.title: Panchaka Rahita remainder
computations.summary: Tithi, Vaaram, Nakshatra, and Lagna ordinals are summed modulo nine to classify dosha.
computations.time_basis: Sunrise snapshot for the day field; recomputed at slot Lagna for Muhurtam.

provenance.note: Formula and remainder meanings have registered source evidence.

limitations: Ordinal naming and activity cautions follow the registered convention.

computations.title: Five-limb Panchanga Shuddhi
computations.summary: Tithi, Vaaram, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana are individually graded and counted.
computations.time_basis: Panchangam day at sunrise.

provenance.note: The implemented count and tables are tested; the exact textual locator remains open.

limitations: A five-limb count is not a complete personal election chart.

computations.title: Pitru Paksha flag
computations.summary: Bhadrapada Krishna Paksha is classified as the ancestral fortnight.
computations.time_basis: Telugu Amanta month and fortnight for the Panchangam day.

provenance.note: The Telugu regional convention is tested but not yet claim-located independently.

limitations: Other regional month conventions can place the named fortnight differently.

computations.title: Sankramana avoidance window
computations.summary: A symmetric sixteen-Ghati interval is placed around exact solar ingress.
computations.time_basis: Sixteen proportional Ghatis before and after ingress.

provenance.note: The duration and placement have registered textual evidence.

limitations: The window is a textual election rule, not uncertainty around the astronomical crossing.

computations.title: Vaaram-Tithi-Nakshatra special Yogas
computations.summary: Table rules identify Sarvartha Siddhi, Amrita Siddhi, Siddha, Visha, Dagdha, and Pushkara Yogas.
outputs: list of applicable special Yoga names
computations.time_basis: Evaluated at the day snapshot and again at slot time where supported.

provenance.note: Python/browser parity is tested, while some table locators remain open.

limitations: Named Yogas with similar names in other traditions are not inferred beyond these exact tables.

computations.title: Nakshatra Vishaghati windows
computations.summary: Nakshatra-specific poison-Ghati offsets produce clipped civil-time windows.
outputs: Vishaghati windows in civil time and Ghatis
computations.time_basis: Nakshatra duration mapped to the sunrise-anchored Ghati scale.

provenance.note: Offsets and clipping are tested; claim-level source coverage remains grouped with mixed daily windows.

limitations: The selected offset table is tradition-specific.

computations.title: Nine-graha sidereal positions
computations.summary: Sidereal longitude produces rashi, Nakshatra, Pada, retrograde state, and next ingress for nine grahas.
computations.time_basis: Requested Julian day, normally local sunrise for daily surfaces.

provenance.note: The same Drik longitude evidence boundary applies to these derived fields.

limitations: Rahu and Ketu use the selected node convention; next-ingress dates are numerical search results and rasi_until is currently rendered as an IST calendar date rather than the requested city's local date.

computations.title: Named Shani transit conditions
computations.summary: Saturn's house from Janma Rashi is labeled as Sade Sati, Ashtama Shani, or Ardhastama Shani where applicable.
computations.time_basis: Transit snapshot relative to natal Moon sign.

provenance.note: Underlying adverse houses have support; conventional names and phases are explicitly bounded.

limitations: Names and phase labels are conventional presentation and not a complete natal transit judgment.

computations.title: Gochara transit verdicts and Vedha
computations.summary: Each graha's house from Janma Rashi is assessed against favourable houses and Vedha blocking rules.
computations.time_basis: Daily transit snapshot relative to natal Moon sign.

provenance.note: Classical house and Vedha tables are claim-located; disclosed node handling is separately registered.

limitations: This is Moon-sign Gochara, not a full natal-chart or Dasha interpretation.

computations.title: Deterministic daily Rasi Phalalu
computations.summary: Computed Gochara facts are rendered into deterministic daily reading text.
computations.time_basis: Daily transit snapshot.

provenance.note: Transit facts inherit verified rule tables; wording and synthesis remain project interpretation.

limitations: Narrative wording is interpretive and must not be treated as individualized professional advice.

computations.title: Model-generated daily Rasi Phalalu
computations.summary: An external model produces prose that is checked against deterministic Gochara facts before acceptance.
computations.time_basis: Daily generated-data batch for the supplied transit snapshot.

provenance.note: Cited transit triples are checked; prose and advice are explicitly generated interpretation.

limitations: Verification prevents unsupported transit facts but cannot make generated prose a classical or professional authority.

computations.title: Abhijit Muhurta window
computations.summary: The midday auspicious interval is derived proportionally from daytime length, except on Wednesday.
computations.time_basis: Proportional local daytime centered on solar midday.

provenance.note: Representative published values are checked; the full textual locator set is incomplete.

limitations: Wednesday omission follows the selected convention.

computations.title: Amrita Kalam windows
computations.summary: Nakshatra-specific Ghati offsets produce auspicious sub-windows.
computations.time_basis: Four-sixtieths of actual Nakshatra duration at the table offset.

provenance.note: Representative values are compared; the table's full locator coverage remains incomplete.

limitations: Offsets follow one maintained table and are clipped to the Panchangam day convention.

computations.title: Ayanam and Rituvu
computations.summary: Solar position classifies the half-year and six seasonal names.
inputs: solar sign or tropical solar longitude
computations.time_basis: Solar position at sunrise.

provenance.note: Calendar semantics need more exact source locators.

limitations: Rituvu uses tropical solar longitude while other fields are predominantly sidereal.

computations.title: Brahma Muhurta window
computations.summary: A fixed pre-sunrise interval identifies Brahma Muhurta.
computations.time_basis: Fixed civil interval before local sunrise.

provenance.note: Representative published values are checked; textual coverage remains grouped.

limitations: The fixed-minute implementation does not scale this window by seasonal day length.

computations.title: Day and night Choghadiya
computations.summary: Weekday-specific sequences label eight proportional day and night segments.
outputs: named proportional day and night windows
computations.time_basis: Eight equal local-day parts and eight equal local-night parts.

provenance.note: Day values have representative comparisons; browser-owned night extension is regression-tested through UI contracts.

limitations: The browser computes the night sequence separately from the Python day sequence.

computations.title: Durmuhurtham windows
computations.summary: Weekday tables select proportional daytime Muhurtas plus the Tuesday night exception.
computations.time_basis: Selected fifteenths of local day or night.

provenance.note: Representative values are compared; exact table locators remain grouped.

limitations: The Tuesday night exception requires next-sunrise context.

computations.title: Daily eclipse and Sutak field
computations.summary: The range-calendar eclipse result is attached to the local Panchangam day.
computations.time_basis: Local Panchangam date with UTC event instants converted for presentation.

provenance.note: This is the daily projection of the canonical eclipse calculation.

limitations: This record owns attachment to the day; event calculation is separately inventoried.

computations.title: Festival date rules
computations.summary: Moment-specific Amanta month, Tithi, weekday, and specialty rules select named festivals.
computations.time_basis: Festival-specific sunrise, Madhyahna, Aparahna, Pradosha, Nishita, or moonrise rule.

provenance.note: Individual 2026 rules have comparisons; the forward-year fixture contains mixed independent and engine-pinned cells.

limitations: The table follows documented Telugu conventions and is not a universal regional festival calendar.

computations.title: Gulika Kalam
computations.summary: A weekday table selects one of eight proportional daytime segments.
computations.time_basis: One eighth of local sunrise-to-sunset daytime.

provenance.note: Representative city/date values are independently compared.

limitations: Weekday-part tables are conventional and location-specific through sunrise/sunset.

computations.title: Karana spans
computations.summary: Each six-degree Moon-Sun elongation interval is mapped to fixed or repeating Karana names.
inputs: Moon-Sun elongation over the Panchangam day
computations.time_basis: Sunrise-anchored day with crossings solved in UTC Julian day.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparisons; non-Drik spans are engine-pinned.

limitations: Boundary times inherit the selected engine's longitude model.

computations.title: Amanta Maasam and Paksham
computations.summary: Bounding new moons and solar signs determine lunar month, Adhika/Nija status, and fortnight.
computations.time_basis: Month at local sunrise bounded by engine-specific new moons.

provenance.note: Semantics need exact locators; non-Drik month outputs are regression-pinned.

limitations: The project follows Telugu Amanta conventions; Purnimanta calendars differ.

computations.title: Nakshatra and Pada
computations.summary: Sidereal lunar longitude selects one of 27 Nakshatras and one of four Padas.
computations.time_basis: Active at local sunrise with UTC boundary crossings.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparisons; non-Drik spans are engine-pinned.

limitations: Names and boundaries inherit engine and ayanamsa choices.

computations.title: Nitya Yoga span
computations.summary: The normalized sum of solar and lunar longitude selects one of 27 Nitya Yogas.
computations.time_basis: Active at local sunrise with UTC crossing search.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparisons; non-Drik spans are engine-pinned.

limitations: This is the 27-part Nitya Yoga, not every other named Yoga vocabulary.

computations.title: Rahu Kalam
computations.summary: A weekday table selects one of eight proportional daytime segments.
computations.time_basis: One eighth of local sunrise-to-sunset daytime.

provenance.note: Representative city/date values are independently compared.

limitations: Weekday-part tables are conventional and location-specific through sunrise/sunset.

computations.title: Solar and lunar Rashi
computations.summary: Thirty-degree sidereal longitude sectors determine solar and lunar signs.
computations.time_basis: Longitude at local sunrise.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparison evidence; non-Drik outputs are engine-pinned.

limitations: Signs follow the selected engine and ayanamsa conventions.

computations.title: Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and moonset
computations.summary: Swiss Ephemeris rise/transit searches produce local sky-marker instants.
outputs: UTC rise/set instants rendered in local timezone
computations.time_basis: Search from local-midnight Julian day with observer coordinates.

provenance.note: Swiss Ephemeris documents the current astronomical-default behavior; issue 177 tracks the Hindu-calendar convention decision and multi-city comparisons.

limitations: All engines use the astronomical upper-limb/refraction default, ignore Location.alt and return codes, and lack a registered multi-city decision fixture for the intended public convention.

computations.title: Samvatsara name
computations.summary: Elapsed Kali-era solar years and the current lunar month map to the 60-year Telugu cycle.
computations.time_basis: Year flips at Chaitra under the southern Chaitradi convention.

provenance.note: Expected years are regression-tested; epoch/offset semantics need exact source documentation.

limitations: Cycle anchoring follows the documented Telugu Chaitradi convention.

computations.title: Daily Sankramana assignment
computations.summary: Exact solar ingress is assigned to a Panchangam day with the project's after-sunset convention.
computations.time_basis: Ingress after local sunset is assigned to the next Panchangam day.

provenance.note: Crossing code is tested; day-assignment semantics need exact locator evidence.

limitations: Day assignment is conventional and distinct from the astronomical crossing instant.

computations.title: Per-instant Panchangam facts
computations.summary: Active Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, lunar Rashi, Vaaram, and special Yogas are recomputed for a slot.
computations.time_basis: Exact evaluated instant; Vaaram remains anchored to the Panchangam sunrise day.

provenance.note: Slot facts inherit the evidence state of the selected engine and calendar semantics.

limitations: The browser mirror currently implements Drik/Lahiri only for slot scoring.

computations.title: Ekadashi, Amavasya, Pournami, and Pradosham flags
computations.summary: Sunrise and deciding-moment Tithi rules assign recurring lunar observances and Ekadashi names.
computations.time_basis: Panchangam-day deciding moments; names use Telugu Amanta convention.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparisons; non-Drik flags are regression-pinned.

limitations: Naming and deciding moments follow documented Telugu conventions.

computations.title: Tithi span
computations.summary: Moon-Sun elongation is divided into thirty twelve-degree lunar days with solved boundaries.
computations.time_basis: Active at local sunrise with boundary crossings solved in UTC Julian day.

provenance.note: Drik has representative comparisons; non-Drik spans are engine-pinned.

limitations: Boundary times differ by engine model and ayanamsa.

computations.title: Sunrise-anchored Vaaram
computations.summary: The weekday is selected for the Panchangam day and remains constant until the next sunrise.
computations.time_basis: Sunrise-to-next-sunrise day, not civil midnight.

provenance.note: The sunrise-day semantic is tested but needs an exact textual locator.

limitations: Civil-midnight weekday expectations can differ before local sunrise.

computations.title: Varjyam windows
computations.summary: Nakshatra-specific Tyajya Ghati offsets produce inauspicious sub-windows.
computations.time_basis: Four-sixtieths of actual Nakshatra duration at the table offset.

provenance.note: Representative values are compared; the table's full locator coverage remains incomplete.

limitations: Offsets follow one maintained table and are clipped to the Panchangam day convention.

computations.title: Yamagandam
computations.summary: A weekday table selects one of eight proportional daytime segments.
computations.time_basis: One eighth of local sunrise-to-sunset daytime.

provenance.note: Representative city/date values are independently compared.

limitations: Weekday-part tables are conventional and location-specific through sunrise/sunset.

computations.title: Chandrabalam
computations.summary: The Moon's house from Janma Rashi is classified for favourability and Puja exceptions.
computations.time_basis: Day or slot lunar Rashi relative to natal Moon sign.

provenance.note: Python/browser behavior is tested; exact source locators for the full verdict vocabulary remain open.

limitations: Nakshatra-to-Rashi without Pada can be ambiguous at sign boundaries.

computations.title: Homahuti and Agnivasa election
computations.summary: Solar/lunar Nakshatra and Tithi/Vaaram remainders produce Homa offering guidance.
computations.time_basis: Evaluated for the candidate slot.

provenance.note: The exact Homahuti and Agnivasa rules have registered locators.

limitations: This is election guidance and does not replace ritual prerequisites or a qualified practitioner; the current low-level reason list labels every Agnivasa remainder as earth-resident even when the admission gate fails, so consumers must rely on the admitted boolean until the tracked transparency fix lands.

computations.title: Planetary Hora windows
computations.summary: Chaldean order and weekday lord assign twelve day and twelve night planetary hours.
computations.time_basis: Twelve equal day parts and twelve equal night parts.

provenance.note: Order and segmentation are parity-tested, but a claim-level source locator is not yet registered.

limitations: Planetary favourability labels in the browser are presentation, not personalized Hora judgment.

computations.title: Personal Lagna position and class
computations.summary: Candidate Lagna is measured from Janma Rashi and classified by mobility and favourable houses.
computations.time_basis: Candidate slot Lagna relative to natal Rashi.

provenance.note: Parity and unit behavior are tested; broad Lagna verdict semantics need claim-level locators.

limitations: This house-only strength is not a complete election-chart Lagna assessment.

computations.title: Daily Lagna transitions
computations.summary: Swiss Ephemeris houses and bisection locate ascendant sign changes through the day.
computations.time_basis: Local sunrise-to-next-sunrise with UTC bisection of ascendant crossings.

provenance.note: Transitions are numerically and integration tested; independent city/date comparison cells are not registered.

limitations: The browser mirror renders generated transitions; it does not independently recompute the ascendant.

computations.title: Activity-specific Muhurta profiles
computations.summary: Source-profile rule tables define admissions, exclusions, preferences, and manual checks per activity.
computations.time_basis: Rules are applied to each candidate day and slot.

provenance.note: The umbrella claim remains needs_locator and grants no authority. At the activity level, 34 of 35 canonical profiles are verified and the remaining generic any profile is an explicit heuristic; no profile is currently contradicted.

limitations: Each activity's evidence state must be read from its own provenance claim; this umbrella record is not a blanket verification claim.

computations.title: Muhurta day diagnosis and slot ranking
computations.summary: Hard exclusions, time-window subtraction, personal strengths, textual preferences, and disclosed heuristics produce ranked slots.
computations.time_basis: Day and night candidate windows evaluated using per-slot Panchangam facts.

provenance.note: Activity gates may have verified sources, but aggregate scores and relative tier bands are disclosed project heuristics.

limitations: Relative rankings mean best available under the inputs, not absolute scriptural quality or professional advice.

computations.title: Nitya Yoga disposition
computations.summary: Each of the 27 Nitya Yogas is classified for slot scoring and partial-window cautions.
computations.time_basis: Active Yoga and candidate slot instant.

provenance.note: Disposition and partial-window behavior are tested; exact claim locators remain open.

limitations: Disposition is one input to Muhurta ranking, not a standalone election verdict; partial-dosha windows currently use a fixed 24 civil minutes per Ghati rather than the proportional sunrise-to-sunrise Ghati clock.

computations.title: Tarabalam
computations.summary: Cyclic distance from Janma Nakshatra produces one of nine Tara names and favourability.
computations.time_basis: Active day or slot Nakshatra relative to birth Nakshatra.

provenance.note: Formula and browser parity are tested; a claim-specific exact locator is not yet registered.

limitations: Tarabalam is one personal factor and should not be presented as a complete Muhurta judgment.

computations.title: Fivefold Tithi family
computations.summary: Tithi ordinal cycles through Nanda, Bhadra, Jaya, Rikta, and Purna families.
computations.time_basis: Active day or slot Tithi.

provenance.note: Family mapping and parity are tested; exact source coverage remains broad.

limitations: Activity-specific use must come from the selected profile rather than a universal family ranking.

computations.title: Daily Guru and Shukra Maudhya
computations.summary: Shortest-arc Sun-planet elongation is compared with configured combustion thresholds.
computations.time_basis: Drik snapshot at local sunrise.

provenance.note: Numerical behavior is tested; exact threshold locators remain under derived-classification debt.

limitations: Only Drik populates outer-planet Maudhya in PanchangamDay.

computations.title: Simha-stha Guru and Shukra
computations.summary: Jupiter or Venus in Simha is flagged for activity-specific restrictions.
computations.time_basis: Drik snapshot at local sunrise.

provenance.note: Flag behavior is tested; exact scope and source locator remain open.

limitations: Only Drik models the required planets; activity consequences are profile-specific.
